Name: adaptive_block_size
Title: Adaptive Block Size: Dynamic Context Window Adjustment for Efficient Training
Experiment: Modify the model to dynamically adjust its block size during training, starting with a smaller block size and gradually increasing it. This could potentially lead to faster initial training and better long-range dependency learning.

Name: layerwise_learning_rates
Title: Layer-wise Learning Rate Adaptation: Optimizing Training Dynamics in Transformer Models
Experiment: Implement layer-wise learning rates, where each transformer layer has its own learning rate. Modify the configure_optimizers function to assign different learning rates to different layers, with deeper layers having lower learning rates. Compare the training dynamics, convergence speed, and final performance with the baseline model.

Name: controlled_text_data_augmentation
Title: Controlled Text Data Augmentation for Improving Robustness in Character-Level Language Models
Experiment: Enhance the get_batch function to selectively apply random character insertion, deletion, or substitution based on specific criteria, such as sequence length or model confidence, with an adjustable parameter to control the intensity of augmentation. Evaluate the effects on training and validation loss, comparing the augmented model's performance to a baseline model trained without any augmentation.

Name: dynamic_curriculum_learning
Title: Dynamic Curriculum Learning: Adaptive Complexity Training for Enhanced Model Robustness
Experiment: Modify the get_batch function to sort training samples based on their lengths and implement a mechanism to dynamically adjust the complexity threshold based on training performance. Start with shorter sequences and progressively sample longer ones as the model improves. Compare training and validation performance against a baseline model trained on randomly sampled data.
